criteria.reason: Opens by naming the faith-versus-equal-education conflict and explicitly weighs both values.
Girls-only class and modified content preserve both religious respect and swimming skills.
Respectful throughout; consults family, avoids stigma, maintains educational goals.
Defers to cantonal rules and authorities but omits the Federal Court ruling; cites no sources.

summary: Accommodation-first proposal that names the tension, offers concrete alternatives, and defers to cantonal authorities, but omits the Federal Court ruling on mixed swimming.
